name: fairfold-assets
description: Build-time asset pipeline for FairFold. No bundler, no SPA, and node_modules never reaches the runtime image.

scripts.vendor: mkdir -p static/js static/vendor/swagger-ui && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js static/js/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.js static/js/chart.min.js && cp node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/swagger-ui.css node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/swagger-ui-bundle.js node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/swagger-ui-standalone-preset.js node_modules/swagger-ui-dist/favicon-32x32.png static/vendor/swagger-ui/
scripts.build: npm run vendor && npm run build:css
scripts.check-budget: gzip -c static/css/tailwind.css | wc -c | awk '{ if ($1 >= 30720) { print "tailwind.css is " $1 " bytes gzipped, budget is 30720"; exit 1 } }'
